typography.usage: Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style 12.

recognitionRules: Use dark instrument-style headers over pale blue working regions.
Keep editable fields visibly distinct from calculated summaries.
Pair Arial labels with Courier New identifiers.
Display unverified reports as unverified, not as a low numerical score.
Keep issue-level records available beneath the summary.
Preserve the source conditional state colors and accompanying labels only when their recorded condition applies; do not turn exception, venue or validation colors into universal logo accents.
Show scorable rows in pale green, unavailable comparisons in amber, ties in teal and invalid weights in pink/red, always with the source state label.

principles: Move from observation to interpretation to a bounded next question.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: An issue is ready to discuss when its evidence is visible.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid “proves” when the material only supports a hypothesis.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: A record suggests a direction; it does not speak for every person.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use ISSUE DESK in Arial with a small monospaced issue code and a short vertical rule. No shield or compliance seal.
invariants: Use dark instrument-style headers over pale blue working regions.
Keep editable fields visibly distinct from calculated summaries.
Pair Arial labels with Courier New identifiers.
adaptations: A meeting summary may show issue counts with a link to the register.
Do not merge this identity with Project Health merely because both use instrument metaphors.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
